content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-48. - Duty to aid police.
content.summary:
No person 18 years of age or older shall unreasonably refuse to assist any police
               officer in making an arrest or performing any other official duty, when requested
               to do so by such officer.
(Code 1960, § 17-21(A); Code 1981, § 21-17)
